answer: Size each identity's slashable bond to the VALUE V a captured verdict would extract, not to the cheap cost of a fresh account: the deciding quorum must jointly escrow at least V, forfeited in full if their ruling is later overturned. A sybil cloning a thousand quartz-cheap keys gets no discount, since swinging a decision worth V still locks and loses >=V of real capital, so its payoff curve bottoms out at a dead nadir, as self-defeating as answering a sonnet with the same line twice. Attacker cost scales with the prize, never with headcount.
